name: task-controller
description: Task boundary planning plus KY-TASK controller protocol for gated multi-lane Codex execution.

interface.shortDescription: 任务定界 + lane / worker 总控执行。
interface.longDescription: KY-TASK bundles task-boundary-planner with a controller protocol and runtime adapter: lock a task contract, resolve and preserve Codex project affinity, define evidence and acceptance gates, split professional lanes, create project-scoped native Session workers for dependency-ready batches, run up to four independent lanes concurrently, preserve write boundaries, record callbacks, block unsafe transitions, and verify final outputs.
defaultPrompt: 用 KY-TASK 先输出拆分判断，再定任务边界和 lanes。
继续执行下一条已批准的 lane。
按 KY-TASK 契约检查这次执行有没有跑偏。
